audit.completenessRule: Require every active flow channel to contain one nonnull count per expected local quarter-hour. Spring DST has 92 slots; other source days have 96. Exclude a day from every bridge if any bridge fails. Sum status partitions, never comprehensive and component sensors together.

limitations: These are designated bicycle-path crossings, not all people or unique travelers.
Manhattan and Williamsburg are possible diversion destinations; relative changes do not isolate lane-caused demand.
The pre-opening baseline includes COVID-19; weather adjustment does not remove pandemic, commuting, tourism or station-network changes.

Brooklyn comprehensive series stitches the former promenade to the roadway bikeway. A hardware/path change at intervention can alter measurement; equal published totals do not prove equal calibration.
Manhattan and Williamsburg added flow channels on 2020-11-23; physical hardware replacements also occur. Completeness checks detect missing records, not calibration changes.
No mode-switch or door-to-door travel-time observations are in this count panel.
The all-three sum uses common valid dates, but cycling via other crossings, on unauthorized paths, or entirely different trips remains outside it.

Recent 2026 months have many incomplete counter days. Their available-day means can be selection-biased; displayEligible is false below 80% common coverage and these months should be omitted from continuous trend lines.
